passage:
workbench — 工作台
When the Maple Street Repair Shop opened in 2019, it had one workbench, two volunteers, and a simple rule: fix first, replace last.

coordinator — 协调人
Maya Chen, the shop's coordinator, says the growth was never planned.

undercut — 以低价削弱（竞争）
Tomasz Nowak, who runs a small electronics shop nearby, argues that free repairs undercut his business.

competence — 能力，胜任
'Short classes can create confidence without competence,' she says.

certified — 获得认证的
Some students may attempt unsafe repairs at home.' Osei would like the shop to offer a longer, certified course.

diverted — 转移（此处指使不进入垃圾填埋场）
In 2023, the shop estimates it diverted 4.2 tonnes of goods from landfill.

estimate — 估计
That figure is an estimate, not a measurement, because the shop weighs items only when volunteers remember to do so.

expansion — 扩张
Nowak calls the expansion 'a warning sign'.
